question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**afford**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given passage is about the '25 years of Mobility in India'.
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**afford**'.
 
• It means 'to have enough money or time to be able to do something. (कुछ करने या ख़रीद सकने के लिए पर्याप्त धन या समय निकाल सकना)
